turns.replyText:
Setting up your Tumble rug for the first time is designed to be simple and stress-free! 🙂

Here is how you can get everything ready:

Prepare the Space: Start by clearing the area and making sure the floor is clean and dry.
Assemble the Rug Pad: Each piece of the rug pad is numbered. Lay them out and lock the puzzle-piece edges together. Make sure the number on each piece is in the upper left-hand corner to ensure they fit correctly.
Place the Rug Cover: Once the pad is assembled, center the rug cover over it.
Tuck the Corners: Tuck the corners of the rug cover into the built-in pockets on the rug pad. This keeps everything smooth and prevents the edges from curling.
Apply Corner Grippers: If your set includes corner grippers (sometimes referred to as sticky pads), apply them after the rug is centered and smoothed out, but before you place any furniture on top. Gently pull the rug tight as you apply them for a secure fit.

For more detailed guidance, including a helpful video, you can visit our Assembly page.

Thank you for being a customer and let us know if you have any questions!
